scoring_justification: Exact paper-reported absorption edge values are not available numerically; only qualitative figure and approximate difference reported. Scoring uses internal artifact consistency and structural plausibility (non-negativity, plausible energy range, Moss–Burstein shift, monotonicity).

outputs.description: Computed absorption coefficient α(ω) of InAs substrates at T=300 K as a function of photon energy for electron densities 2×10^18 cm⁻³ and 5×10^18 cm⁻³.
Photon energies at which the absorption coefficient equals 100 cm⁻¹ for each doping level, extracted from the CSV.

output_contract.notes: The checker will recompute absorption edge energies from absorption_spectra.csv, compare them to hidden gold values (±5 meV), and verify the Moss–Burstein shift (edge for n=5×10^18 > n=2×10^18 by ≥5 meV). The absorption_edges.json values are checked for consistency with the CSV-based recomputation.

steps.description: Recompute edge energies and verify physical plausibility (non-negativity, range, Moss-Burstein shift, monotonicity).
Verify JSON edge energies are consistent with recomputed values from CSV (tolerance ±0.001 eV).
